items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewer states 'I used to come there all the time because Louis James was an old friend of mine.' The interviewee does not respond to confirm a personal relationship with Louis James.

ctx.x: Oh, Father Frank left just before he came. Yeah. Uh huh, so he came.
Yeah, well I used to go there. That was Louis James who used to play there sometimes. You know Louis James? He used to be there in that church. He was a bass player too. Uh huh. From Hickory Street.
Oh yeah. Well that's all my members of my family. I got kind of forgotten when I stood and made some holes around there. So they were all new men. I used to take care of the hunger boys.
